bio: Should you see the multi-armed form of Mekiddo bearing down upon you, remain tranquil – for blissful annihilation soon awaits. Born from the mind of a Cambion sage, who meditated atop a stone pillar for a thousand years, Mekiddo's eternal tranquility is matched by its ability to inflict total destruction on its enemies. Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.
